name: Anime sky
description: A painted anime sky: a deep blue gradient over towering cumulus clouds shaded in a few crisp bands, lit at their edges by a glaring sun with soft lens-flare rings, drifting slowly.

name: Sakura petals
description: Cherry blossom petals drifting down on a breeze at three depths, each notched petal fluttering and flipping over as it falls.

name: Shoujo sparkles
description: A shoujo manga backdrop: a soft pastel gradient filled with rising rimmed bubbles and long-rayed sparkles twinkling, the dreamy screen behind a romantic close-up.

name: Gloom lines
description: The manga gloom over a character's despair: wavering vertical lines hanging down from the top of the frame into a shadow that darkens towards it, swaying slowly.

name: Menacing
description: The manga menace: heavy outlined ゴ glyphs climbing both sides of the frame, throbbing and trembling one after another while something ominous happens, on a transparent loop.

name: Eyecatch
description: An anime eyecatch card, the bumper either side of an ad break: two diagonal colour bands slash across from opposite sides, a starburst spins open and the show's title slams in over it with its subtitle, holds, then everything sweeps away.

name: Manga tone
description: Any picture printed as a black-and-white manga page: inked outlines, mid-tones cut from screentone dot sheets, shadows in solid black or cross-hatching, on off-white paper.

name: Long exposure
description: Footage seen through a shutter held open: moving water turns silky and crowds melt away, or the brightest lights draw streaks, while whatever stays still stays sharp.

name: Frame echo
description: Each frame of footage with fading copies of the frames just before it, so moving things leave a trail of ghosts.

name: Step frames
description: Footage that holds each frame a while at a low frame rate, for a choppy stop-motion or animated-on-twos look.

name: Stutter
description: Footage that catches on short snatches, replaying each a few times before it moves on, like a skipping record.

name: Freeze frame
description: Footage that stops dead on one frame, holds it, then plays on from where it stopped.

name: Boomerang
description: Footage played forwards then backwards, again and again, sped up like a social-media boomerang.

name: Reverse
description: Footage played backwards from its last frame to its first.

name: Speed ramp
description: Footage that eases from full speed into slow motion round one moment and back out again, like a sports replay.

name: Speed change
description: Footage played slower or faster throughout: slow motion with blended in-between frames, or a sped-up time-lapse with its motion blurred.

name: Wireframe reveal
description: A picture first seen as a schematic wireframe on black: pale panels with fine hatching, outlines and coloured circuit traces running along their edges. Then the real picture builds up block by block behind a glitching front, holds, and folds back into the wireframe.

name: LED net
description: A picture shown through a net of tiny LEDs draped in folds like fabric: each light glows with a cross-shaped star flare, mostly in one cool tint with drifting patches of rainbow colour, dark parts of the picture leaving the lights off so shapes stand out as silhouettes.

name: Glass writing
description: Words written on in one glowing glass stroke, letter by letter as a pen would, in joined-up script or print; give the path words as {"text": …} or any path.

name: Light strand text
description: Tall, heavy letters built from hundreds of fine strands of light, steel blue to white, that fall into place from top to bottom, the letters' cores first and their edges last, then curve along the edges, brightening and fading as light slides down them, with a few warm threads running through and a glow along the lower edges.
